message:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The `wolfSSL_HmacCopy` function copies the HMAC state, but the issue is a "Use-of-uninitialized-value" in `wolfSSL_HmacCopy`. Let me look at the cryptofuzz module that calls this to understand how the input is processed.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>grep -n "CTX_Copier\|copyCTX\|HMAC_CTX_copy" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/cryptofuzz/modules/wolfcrypt-openssl/module_internal.h | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
